source_text: Labeling the procedure "mutilation" overlooks this framework, equating a low-risk, benefit-accruing intervention—comparable to routine ear piercing in some cultures—with non-therapeutic harm, while empirical data supports parental discretion as a bulwark against overreach that could parallel compelled reversals of other childhood norms. [74]
